summary: Prewarm swap exposes shadow routing and breaks tenant pin affinity during canary rollout
description: Issue summary: During a scheduled canary promote for KiteMaps' dedicated pool we observed an unexpected split in model-version pin affinity across tenant sessions after the 'prewarm swap' step completed. Impact: ~18% of requests for a pinned tenant cohort were routed to fallback model variants resulting in inconsistent outputs and several user-reported mismatches. Environment: prod (us-east), dedicated pool id: dp-34-km, canary cohort weight: 10% -> 50% planned gradual rollout, prewarm_swap flag enabled. Steps to reproduce: 1) Create dedicated pool with tenant pin to redwood-v1.3. 2) Schedule a canary promote with prewarm_swap enabled and default healthprobe (200ms). 3) At promotion step, trigger a synthetic traffic surge (concurrent requests ~3x baseline) while letting prewarm hosts enter service. 4) Observe routing cache snapshots and session tokens. Observed behavior: - After prewarm swap completed, ~18% of sessions lost version affinity and began hitting fallback model variant redwood-v1.2. - Edge logs show X-Tenant-Session header missing on some requests forwarded to the new prewarm hosts. - Routing cache shows duplicate cohort entries for the tenant (one with pin, one without). - Health probes for prewarm hosts returned success but their session-handshake path skipped affinity initialization. Expected behavior: prewarm swap should not cause loss of tenant pin affinity; new hosts should initialize routing state before receiving production traffic. Logs/metrics attached: - edge-router logs (snippet): "WARN: missing-session-token; host prewarm-12 accepted request without session init" - canary-coordinator timeline: prewarm_swap completed at 14:12:06Z, cohort-weight adjustment started at 14:12:09Z - routing-cache dump: tenant_km_23 -> [pin:redwood-v1.3 (count:82), pin:unset (count:18)] Preliminary hypothesis: The prewarm swap flow is introducing a race where the edge sidecar forwards a small portion of traffic to newly promoted prewarm hosts before the routing-cache / cohort-affinity reconciliation completes. A secondary factor: a recent sidecar header sanitizer change (PR referenced above) removes empty cookies/headers and may be stripping the X-Tenant-Session on certain keepalive connections created during prewarm. Combined, this results in newly promoted hosts processing requests without establishing the tenant pin and therefore triggering fallback routing logic. Mitigation/workaround applied: - Immediately rolled back prewarm_swap flag for KiteMaps rollout and paused the canary progression. - Forced a routing-cache reconciliation job for tenant_km_23 which re-established pins for affected session IDs. - Customer advised to retry affected requests; provided temporary rate-limit increase window for retries. Next steps (in progress): - SRE to reproduce race in staging with prewarm_swap + header sanitizer toggled (assigned to Lena). - Engineering to review sidecar header sanitizer PR and add explicit pass-through for X-Tenant-Session during prewarm handoffs. - Add ordering gate in canary-coordinator: only switch traffic to prewarm hosts after routing-affinity confirmation. - Postmortem and follow-up changelog entry scheduled after resolution.
